$comment: The NAMES are community archetype names used across the NBA 2K series, not confirmed NBA 2K27
in-game build names — 2K27's official archetype naming is still unknown.
The CONSTRAINTS were rewritten on 2026-08-25 to land on real 2K27 thresholds taken from the badge
cost charts and the community 'best value attribute thresholds' sheet, so each preset parks on a
badge or animation unlock instead of a round number. Which thresholds each archetype should chase
is still an opinion — the numbers are sourced, the choice of them is not.
`priorities` maps a priorityGroup id (see attributes.json) to a weight from 0-100.
`constraints.minimums` are HARD floors the optimizer must satisfy or report as infeasible.
`constraints.softTargets` are 'try to reach' values that add score but are not required.
2K27's builder names a build itself rather than making you pick an archetype off a list, so these
are OBSERVED LABELS for specific bodies, not presets a player selects. They are recorded here
because they are the only confirmed 2K27 build names in the dataset — the eight archetypes below
Add one per body as it is seen in the NBA 2K HQ app. Do not guess a name for a body you have not
opened: the naming rule (body only? body plus allocation?) is not known.

verification.source: NBA 2K HQ app MyPLAYER builder, screenshots supplied 2026-08-25.

$bodyNote: Retargeted 2026-08-25 onto 6'11" / 210 lb / 6'11", the ONE frame whose caps have been read off
the real builder. Every other preset sits on modelled caps that measure ~13 points off, so this
is currently the only preset whose ceilings are facts.
The real caps also vindicate the archetype on this frame: 94 Mid-Range and 91 Three-Point with a
70 Block and an 80 Defensive Rebound is a stretch big and nothing else. The previous suggestion
(6'10" / 235 / 7'3") had soft targets — Block 84, Defensive Rebound 87, Offensive Rebound 82 —
that the modelled caps allowed and that may well be unreachable in the real builder.
In-game the NBA 2K HQ builder labels this frame BUCKET CHASER. See officialBuildNames below.

constraints.$note: Every value below is a real threshold from the sourced data AND is at or under the verified cap for this frame, so none of them is aspirational.
